title: MoNcKiE's Apples
description: Enhance your survival with powerful apples, new pillager and evoker drop. Adds new ore apples, each with a tier and new recipes.
body:
THIS MOD IS INSPIRED BY: [Iron Apples [FORGE] by tbnrfluffy654](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iron-apples-forge)
#



## 🍎 The mod adds 9 new apples 🍎: 
Coal Apple, Copper Apple, Iron Apple, Redstone Apple, Lapis Apple, Emerald Apple, Diamond Apple, Netherite Apple & Rotten Apple

Each apple features its own tier and effects

## ⚔️ New Axe & Item Drop ⚔️

Also MoNcKiE's Apples adds:
  The Ominous Battle Axe
  Ominous Essence, which is needed to craft the Rotten Apple. Its dropped by Pillagers and Evokers.

**💡 TO VIEW THE OMINOUS BATTLE AXE RECIPE, USE [Just Enough Items (JEI)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei) 💡**
